arguments.text: 10 km, 8 out-and-back legs of 1250 m; leg 1 (heading N) is against the current (push about -0.33 m/s), back legs with it. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) drag/weed: watch push_local drops within a leg, check whether a clear_rudder helped (speed back up); (2) pod honesty: compare pod power with heart rate and GPS; if the pod drifts, set pod_gain so the pacer reads true effort; (3) radio/course: on any course change set_race_distance and tell the paddler; (4) critical power check mid-race from heart-rate trend at steady effort (HR levels off = below CP); (5) answer the paddler (reassure if fine). Keep cues few; do not waste calls.

arguments.name: push_local_drop
arguments.source:
w = window("push_local_mps", 120)
recent = mean(w[-20:])
before = mean(w[:-20])
recent - before
arguments.description: local push in the last 20 s minus the 100 s before (within a leg this flags drag such as weed or a pod reading high)

arguments.message: local push fell within a leg: weed/drag or a pod reading high - check
